sentences.text: To counter a known current, draw a current diagram.
Draw your intended track from the start toward your destination.
From the start, draw the current vector: its set and its drift for one hour.
From the end of the current vector, set your dividers to your boat speed, and swing an arc until it crosses the intended track.
The line from the end of the current vector to that crossing is your course to steer.
The distance from the start to the crossing, along the track, is your speed made good.
